events.evidence: Amazon becomes the second trillion-dollar company in the United States
Typhoon Jebi kills at least 11 people in Japan, while more than 300 are injured. It is considered the strongest typhoon in the country in 25 years
A Microsoft Azure datacenter in Texas goes down due to a cooling system failure. Outages in cloud services were reported worldwide

label.note: Tech and disaster headlines mixed; Amazon milestone supportive but typhoon/Azure outage risk-off.
